title: Hotel & Travel Booking
summary: A booking site sells rooms it does not own. Availability and prices live in thousands of hotel and supplier systems that are slow, rate-limited, and sometimes wrong, so search runs mostly on a cache and the live supplier is checked only when it matters. Booking is a multi-step saga across systems: hold the room, take payment, confirm with the supplier, and undo each step cleanly if a later one fails.

walkthrough.title: Search
walkthrough.text: A traveller searches Lisbon, 12-15 March, 2 adults. Thousands of hotels may match.

walkthrough.title: Answer from the availability cache
walkthrough.text: Results come from a cache of rates and availability that suppliers push or that is refreshed by polling, so search takes milliseconds without calling every hotel.

walkthrough.title: Verify the live price
walkthrough.text: When the traveller opens a hotel or starts checkout, a real-time call to the supplier confirms the exact rate. A cached price can be stale, and showing a different total at payment loses trust.

walkthrough.title: Start the booking and hold the room
walkthrough.text: The booking service creates a booking in PENDING state with an idempotency key and asks the supplier to hold the room for a few minutes.

walkthrough.title: Authorise payment
walkthrough.text: The card is authorised (not yet captured) for the total, with 3-D Secure if required.

walkthrough.title: Confirm with the supplier
walkthrough.text: The supplier confirms and returns a confirmation number, the booking becomes CONFIRMED, and payment is captured. If confirmation fails, the saga releases the hold and voids the authorisation.

walkthrough.title: Send the itinerary
walkthrough.text: The traveller receives the confirmation email and itinerary. Later changes and cancellations follow the same saga pattern with refunds.

data.label: Traveller
responsibilities: Searches, compares, and books.
Expects the price shown to be the price charged.
Gets a confirmation they can trust at check-in.

failureModes.scenario: Price changes at the payment step
failureModes.mitigation: Re-verify the price on hotel page view and before payment.

data.label: Search & Pricing API

output.name: Offers
output.type: Ranked hotels with cached rates; live-verified on select

responsibilities: Finds matching hotels and ranks them by relevance and value.
Uses cached availability for broad search, live checks for detail.
Applies markups, taxes, and currency conversion.

failureModes.impact: Suppliers rate-limit or ban you; search is slow.
failureModes.mitigation: Cache for search, live calls only for the few hotels a user opens.
Smart caching and request budgets per supplier.

data.label: Availability Cache

input.name: Updates
input.type: Availability, rates, and inventory pushed by channel managers

output.name: Lookup
output.type: Rooms + price per night for the date range

responsibilities: Stores availability by hotel × room × date.
Absorbs search volume so suppliers are not called.
Tracks freshness per entry.

failureModes.mitigation: Short TTLs for hot dates; invalidate on failed bookings.
Monitor feed freshness; fall back to polling.

data.label: Suppliers & Channel Managers

output.name: Responses
output.type: Live rate, hold ID, confirmation number

responsibilities: Own the real inventory and prices.
Hold and confirm rooms on request.
Enforce rate limits and cancellation policies.

failureModes.impact: Booked at the hotel but not in your system, or the reverse.
failureModes.mitigation: Idempotent confirm with your booking reference; reconcile by querying status.
Multiple suppliers for the same hotel; hide unbookable offers.

data.label: Booking Service (Saga)

output.name: Booking
output.type: PENDING → HELD → PAID → CONFIRMED (or rolled back)

responsibilities: Runs the booking as a series of steps, each with an undo action.
Persists state after every step so a crash can resume.
Reconciles uncertain outcomes with suppliers.

failureModes.impact: Charged with no room, or a room with no payment.
failureModes.mitigation: Durable workflow (e.g. Temporal) that resumes or compensates.
Retry compensations; holds and authorisations also expire on their own.

data.label: Payments
responsibilities: Reserves funds before the supplier confirms.
Captures only after a confirmed booking.
Voids or refunds when the saga rolls back.

failureModes.impact: Refund needed when the supplier fails.
failureModes.mitigation: Authorise first, capture only on CONFIRMED.

failureModes.impact: Customer charged a different amount than shown.
failureModes.mitigation: Lock the FX rate at quote time.

data.label: Confirmations & Itinerary
responsibilities: Sends confirmations with supplier reference numbers.
Keeps the itinerary updated on changes.
Reminds travellers before check-in.

failureModes.mitigation: Booking also visible in the account; resend option.
Reconfirm with the hotel days before arrival.
